title: Binary inner product neighbor
statement: For a positive natural number $m$, split a vector in the $(2m)$-dimensional cube over the field with two elements into blocks $x,y$ of length $m$. At index $0$, set the new first-block coordinate to $x_0y_0+1$ and the new second-block coordinate to $1$; leave all other coordinates unchanged, then concatenate the blocks.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a vector of length $2m$ over the field with two elements
